data_design: 114 non-hybrid plants, three Cirsium taxa x 2 reproductive sexes; individual-matched middle leaf and involucre measurements; descriptive post-outcome exploration, conditional plant bootstrap.

biology.leaf_mm: Spi_L = terminal spine length on largest lateral lobe of middle leaf
biology.bract_mm: (Ibr_W - Inv_W) / 2 = outward bract tip width extension on head outline, not botanical spine length
biology.relative_bract: Inv_Sp-1 = Ibr_W/Inv_W-1; bract spinosity/fuzziness and geometry, not same metric as Lf_Sp

boundaries: An apparent zero correlation with 95% CI -0.18..0.20 is NOT evidence of independence or equivalence, and within-group sign heterogeneity is not a demonstrated selective sign switch.
Phyllary tip-width contrast is not true spine length, force or sharpness; a quarter of heads show zero added width in the proxy, all C. acaulon.
Stem/leaf developmental position, photo geometry, botanically verified actual spines, and common-garden genotype/population data are needed before a causal biological interpretation.
Distinct trait-level results should not be spliced into Azami GEB's frozen inference as if originally preregistered.
Reproductive contact, seed predation, parasitism, and viable achenes are not measured in the morphometrics source.
